intro: 5 pieces of cempedak goreng give about 350 kcal (estimate). More than half the calories come from the batter and the oil it soaks up while frying.
diet: Yes, but treat it as a once-in-a-while snack. 5 pieces is almost the same as a plate of rice with lauk. If you want some, take 2 to 3 pieces and share the rest. During cempedak season, pick either fried or fresh for that day.
tips: Buy one small pack and share with your office mates. Take just 2 pieces.
Drain on kitchen paper first to remove some of the oil.
At home, try a thin coat of batter and cook in the air fryer.

swap.name: Fresh cempedak, 5 pieces
swap.why: Same cempedak taste and smell, but no batter and no oil. You save more than 200 kcal.

faq.q: What flour makes cempedak goreng crispy?
faq.a: Many people use wheat flour with a bit of rice flour and cold water. A thin batter is crispier and soaks up less oil.

faq.q: Can I make cempedak goreng in an air fryer?
faq.a: Yes. Coat with a slightly thick batter, spray a bit of oil, and cook at about 180°C for 10 to 12 minutes. The texture is not 100% the same, but still sedap.

faq.q: Why is my cempedak goreng so oily?
faq.a: Usually the oil is not hot enough. Make sure the oil is really hot before frying, and don't fry too many at once.
